name: libredwg
why: A DWG file format reader and utility suite, a real look into a proprietary binary format from CAD.

brief.what_it_is: LibreDWG is a free C library, with a set of example command-line applications, for reading and writing DWG files, the native binary format of AutoCAD. Per the homepage, the reader takes DWG (and can also read DXF and JSON) and the writer converts from DWG, DXF or JSON, or builds a drawing from scratch. Outputs include DXF and JSON conversions, an initial SVG and PostScript conversion, rewritten DWG files (saveas), and text search and layer listing tools (dwggrep and dwglayer). The homepage says the decoder is done but the writer is only good enough for R1.1 through R2000.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage says LibreDWG aims to be a free replacement for the OpenDWG libraries, since DWG is AutoCAD's native file format. It is based on LibDWG, originally written by Felipe Castro.
brief.install_notes: The homepage gives no build or install steps. Source tarballs come from the GNU mirrors, and it recommends a nearby mirror. Windows pre-releases and daily snapshots are on GitHub. Development checkout and build instructions are on the LibreDWG hackers' wiki, linked from the homepage. Test releases are on the GNU alpha server. I did not open the manual, so I cannot confirm the dependencies or build toolchain.
brief.standout: It is a clean-room-style free reimplementation of a proprietary binary CAD format, and it ships a family of small command-line tools (the executables list includes dwg2SVG, dwg2dxf, dxf2dwg, dwgread, dwgwrite and others) on top of the library. It is a GNU project, so it sits under the GNU umbrella rather than a typical GitHub-first release.
brief.status: Maintained. The homepage says GNU LibreDWG is currently maintained by Reini Urban, and it points to active GitLab and GitHub mirrors and daily snapshots. The homepage's own 'Updated' stamp reads 2024/02/04, and I saw no release version or date. The project describes itself as in beta.
brief.caveats: The homepage calls the project beta: some very advanced R2010+ entities fail to read and are skipped, and the writer only covers R1.1 through R2000. The API should stay mostly stable but is not guaranteed. The library is GPL v3 or later. The homepage's brew description is only 'DWG utilities'. The homepage does not list the command-line tools, and I did not verify that each listed executable exists.
quotes: GNU LibreDWG is a free C library to handle DWG files.
It aims to be a free replacement for the OpenDWG libraries.
LibreDWG is in beta development stage. Not all planned features are yet completed, but the API should stay mostly stable.
fetch_log: https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/ - fetched OK; the GNU homepage with project description, status, maintainers and licence. The linked manual, reference and DWG spec pages were not followed.
